content:
maya (Marketing): Drafted a lightweight one-pager focused on regulated verticals: 'Secure inference at a glance'. Need quick feedback for the Tuesday webinar pack.

noah (Demand): Drop the link. We want to put it behind the gated webinar asset.

maya (Marketing): https://redwood.example/s/secure-inference-brief (preview). Headline, 3 bullets per deploy mode focused on security guarantees, short SLA callouts, 2 CTAs: 'Request compliance kit' and 'Schedule SOC review'.

lia (Product): Can we standardize the SLA phrasing to avoid overpromising? Hosted 99.9% best-effort, Dedicated 99.95% reserved pool, Private contractual. For security bullets note: KMS, audit logs, optional HSM, and SOC2 support.

omar (Field): Please add a one-liner routing: compliance-kit -> solutions, SOC review -> legal/security queue. Also add a sample SOC review email template.

rita (Design): Qs: color palette? icons? Need mobile layout.

maya (Marketing): Palette: Hosted=green, Dedicated=teal, Private=navy. Use small lock icons for security. Provide a 2-column mobile layout. File size target <250KB.

anya (PMM): For messaging iteration, test CTA copy: A) 'Request compliance kit' B) 'Get compliance & SLA kit'. Also test button color (green vs navy). Track via UTMs.

tom (Growth): Routing: readiness kit clicks -> tag=comp_kit, SOC review -> tag=soc_review. I'll add webhook mapping. UTMs: campaign=secure_brief, content={variant}.

noah (Demand): Add a benchmark line? Security-focused buyers care less about raw latency but maybe include 'Typical p95 latency for Hosted ~120ms on short convos (internal)'. Mark internal.

lia (Product): Fine, mark internal and add the footer note: 'Benchmarks depend on workload and model choice; contact us for tailored numbers.'

omar (Field): I'll prep the SOC email and sample responses. Also recommend adding 'data residency options' one-liner for regulated buyers.

maya (Marketing): Plan: Rita to update design for mobile + web, Lia to confirm copy, Anya to set up A/B variants, Tom to wire routing + UTMs, Noah to add landing benchmark line. Ship target: Tue AM.

rita (Design): I'll produce SVG + PNG + compressed JPG. Filenames secure_inference_brief_v1.{svg,png,jpg}. Will include alt text and a 1-liner rep note.

noah (Demand): Landing & email snippets drafted. Short subject: 'Webinar: Secure inference best practices' Long subject: 'Secure inference for regulated apps  SLAs, compliance controls, and deployment choices'

lia (Product): Added the compliance line: 'Supports KMS, audit logs, optional HSM, and SOC2 alignment; contractual controls for Private.'

anya (PMM): A/B plan posted to /marketing/experiments/secure_brief_ab. Objective: compliance kit CTR and SOC review request rate.

tom (Growth): Webhook mapping and UTM template added to the asset notes. Example: ?utm_source=field&utm_campaign=secure_brief&utm_medium=onepager&utm_content={variant}

omar (Field): SOC email template added to #sales-playbooks and linked in the asset comments.

maya (Marketing): Uploaded final assets: https://redwood.example/s/secure-inference-brief/v1. All set for Tuesday morning.

rita (Design): Confirmed uploads. Added small 'how to respond' snippets for reps in the asset notes.

noah (Demand): Landing and email copies uploaded to /marketing/webinar/secure_brief.

anya (PMM): Will start the A/B test the day of launch and report results after 10k impressions.

maya (Marketing): Great work. If any last edits, DM me by Monday 4pm. Otherwise archiving this thread.
